# The Publicist as Institutional Infrastructure — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-tofr-08422
Voiceover: The image is a distinct authored work around fashion; the clothes, staging, model, commission, publication, and photograph do not collapse into one ownership question.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Toni Frissell Collection, Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

Rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

### 8–16s — CA05-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · FRAME — What is the house asking the public to understand?. Write the evidenced proposition, intended audience, context, proof, exclusions, affected people, and correction condition. Separate a useful frame from a claim the available record cannot support.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CA05-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · RELATE — Which relationships carry the frame?. Map journalists, editors, critics, stylists, talent, institutions, buyers, creators, community authorities, platforms, and internal spokespeople. Record the purpose, relevant disclosure, access terms, embargo, conflicts, and who is excluded.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CA05-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · GOVERN — Who may say, approve, reuse, and retain what?. Define scope of services, spokesperson authority, substantiation, review time, confidential information, identity and image permissions, media and territory, archive copies, post-term use, credit, correction, takedown, and termination from the actual agreement.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CA05-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · REMEMBER — What enters the institutional record?. Preserve final releases, pitches where appropriate, media lists under proper privacy controls, approvals, corrections, placements, refusals, captions, credits, rights evidence, and decision context. The archive should record how public meaning was made—not only the resulting coverage.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S39
Voiceover: Universal Electronic Records Management Requirements, Version 3 is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer
